scheme_name: KALIA (Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation)
description: A comprehensive welfare package designed to accelerate agricultural prosperity and reduce poverty by providing direct financial support to farmers and landless agricultural households.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 per year (₹5,000 each for Kharif and Rabi seasons) for cultivators, plus ₹12,500 one-time support for landless agricultural households for allied activities.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers holding up to 2 hectares of cultivable land in Odisha
Landless agricultural households and vulnerable farming families
Must not be an institutional landholder or tax-paying citizen
documents: Land Holding Document (RoR) / Krushak Odisha ID
application_mode: Online via KALIA / Krushak Odisha Portal

description: Provides collateral-free institutional credit to sharecroppers, tenant farmers, and landless agricultural workers through Joint Liability Groups (JLGs).
benefits: Collateral-free, interest-subsidized crop loans up to ₹50,000 per season per group member.
eligibility: Landless sharecroppers, tenant farmers, and agricultural workers in Odisha
Must form Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) consisting of 4 to 5 members
application_mode: Offline via Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) / Local Banks

description: Incentivizes commercial agricultural and allied enterprises by offering substantial capital investment subsidies to individual farmers and entrepreneurs.
benefits: Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS) of 40% to 50% (up to ₹50 lakh) on the fixed capital cost of setting up eligible agri-enterprises.
eligibility: Agri-entrepreneurs, individual farmers, and self-help groups (SHGs) in Odisha
SC/ST, women, and agricultural graduates receive higher subsidy caps (50%)

description: Promotes the cultivation, processing, and consumption of climate-resilient millets across rainfed and tribal agricultural regions.
benefits: Incentive cash transfers up to ₹12,000/hectare spread over 3 years, free seed kits, processing machinery grants, and assured procurement at MSP.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating millets (ragi, foxtail, jowar) in designated project blocks of Odisha
application_mode: Online via Krushak Odisha Portal / Block Agriculture Office

description: A state-supported agricultural risk mitigation scheme providing financial protection against yield losses caused by natural disasters and pest infestations.
benefits: 100% state-funded crop insurance providing coverage up to ₹30,000 per hectare for major food crops.
eligibility: All registered landholding and tenant farmers in Odisha cultivating notified crops

description: Subsidizes modern agricultural implements to reduce labor dependence, lower cultivation costs, and increase crop productivity.
benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) subsidy ranging from 40% to 75% on tractors, power tillers, rotavators, and harvesters.
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land in Odisha registered on the Agrinet portal
application_mode: Online via Odisha Agrinet / DBT Agriculture Portal

scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana - Odisha Organic Mission
description: Encourages cluster-based organic farming practices, soil rejuvenation, and eco-friendly agricultural inputs.
benefits: Financial support up to ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic inputs, vermicompost units, and organic certification.
eligibility: Farmers forming organic clusters of minimum 20 hectares in designated districts
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Office / Cluster Representative

description: Constructs check dams across minor streams to conserve surface water and provide critical irrigation to surrounding farmlands.
benefits: 100% government-funded development of local water harvesting check dams providing gravity flow or lift irrigation.
eligibility: Community farming groups and farmers in water-stressed or rainfed areas of Odisha
application_mode: Offline via Executive Engineer (Minor Irrigation) / Pani Panchayat

description: Supports smallholders and women SHGs in establishing dairy units, boosting milk production, and creating sustainable rural livelihoods.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on purchasing milch cows/buffaloes, cattle shed construction, and fodder cultivation.
eligibility: Individual farmers, landless laborers, and women SHG members in Odisha
application_mode: Online via Chief District Veterinary Office / OMFED Portal

description: Empowers traditional rural artisans and agro-based cottage craft workers through toolkit grants and direct market access.
benefits: Grants up to ₹50,000 for modern machinery toolkits, stipend for skill upgradation, and listing on state e-commerce portals.
eligibility: Registered rural artisans and agro-cottage workers residing in Odisha
application_mode: Offline via District Industries Center (DIC) / Utkalika
